item.title: BATIC 2026 Sets the Stage for the Future of AI, Connectivity, and Digital Infrastructure
item.summary: Telkom Indonesia and Telin bring together industry leaders across AI, cloud, connectivity, and digital infrastructure to accelerate enterprise transformation and regional collaboration.
